pages.text: The Extended Upgrade can directly convert advanced machines into extended advanced machines, granting 8 upgrade slots.$(br2)$(bold)Usage$()$(br2)Hold the Extended Upgrade and right-click any advanced machine to convert. After conversion:$(br2)$(li)The machine becomes the corresponding extended advanced machine$(li)Original items and settings are preserved$(li)The Extended Upgrade item is consumed$(br2)$(bold)Supported Machines$()

| T2 Machine | Converts To | |------------|-------------| | Clicker T2 | Extended Clicker | | Block Breaker T2 | Extended Block Breaker | | Block Placer T2 | Extended Block Placer | | Block Swapper T2 | Extended Block Swapper | | Dropper T2 | Extended Dropper | | Sensor T2 | Extended Sensor | | Fluid Collector T2 | Extended Fluid Collector | | Fluid Placer T2 | Extended Fluid Placer | | Advanced Time Accelerator | Extended Time Accelerator |
